integrity: Written proof and executable exact symbolic checks provided; the finite computations do not certify the infinite theorem. No independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proves GD count for the standard block-monomial complex scroll-ruling embedding with d>=2 and n_i>=2, not arbitrary Grassmann models, arbitrary metrics, or real-minimum counts. Historic priority remains provisional; the earlier GD introduction was not fully inspected. Proof is same-model reviewed, not independently audited.
title: Grassmann distance degree equals Euclidean distance degree for every rational-normal-scroll ruling curve
